A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DiffusionBlocks work and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–H. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of the equations, figures, tables and limited revisions.

before.justification: v3 reports original classification and generation experiments in Section 5, additional experiments in Appendix F, and measured training times in Appendix H.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendices F and H, including benchmark performance and measured training times.

M1.justification: The network conversion, noise conditioning, independent denoising objectives, equi-probability partitioning and architecture adaptations remain unchanged in Sections 2–3 and Appendices B–D.

E1.justification: Both versions use CIFAR-100, CIFAR-10, ImageNet, Tiny ImageNet, text8, LM1B and OpenWebText for the same classification and generation tasks. The revised OpenWebText sequence length is a setting change within retained coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every reported comparison, including Forward-Forward in Table 1 and Backprop, NoProp-DT, NoProp-CT and NoProp-FM in Table 6. The original end-to-end model baselines are also retained.

E3.justification: Appendix E.4 changes the stated OpenWebText training sequence length from 3072 to 1024 and the MAUVE scaling factor from 0.2 to 2. These are limited but substantive reported setting revisions; the PDFs do not establish whether experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The NoProp comparison, partitioning-strategy and layer-allocation ablations, and block-count studies in Section 5.6 and Appendix F retain the same questions and result entries. Repairing the ablation-setup sentence adds no new analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report the minimum of three FID evaluations in Appendix E.2 and wall-time averages over 100 iterations in Appendix H. No repeated-run counts, seed information, uncertainty intervals or statistical testing practices change.

E6.justification: All numerical result entries in Tables 1–12 and the associated qualitative findings are unchanged. Table 4 retains its MAUVE and perplexity scores despite the revised reported settings in Appendix E.4; no new performance results are supplied.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(13), the masked-diffusion derivation, and the memory and computation arguments are unchanged. The spacing adjustment around an Equation (13) reference does not revise mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about independent block training, memory reduction, broad architectural applicability and competitive performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations involving specialization, curriculum learning and block-count tradeoffs are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations and future directions concerning matching dimensions, larger models, pretrained-model conversion and partitioning granularity.

D1.justification: Appendix E.4 revises two reproducibility parameters: OpenWebText sequence length changes from 3072 to 1024, and MAUVE scaling from 0.2 to 2. Other implementation details, hardware information and code/data access disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography and research positioning are unchanged, including Section 4's comparisons with NoProp, earlier block-wise training methods and stage-specific diffusion models.

P1.justification: Section 5.6.2 replaces the malformed phrase 'described ectiveness of each component' with 'described in Section 5.2.' Equation-reference spacing and the arXiv version/date stamp also change. The section organization and remaining narrative are retained.

P2.justification: All figures and tables retain their captions, structure and placement. Rendered-page comparison shows differences confined to the edited prose and version/date stamp, with no figure, table or page-layout redesign.

improvement.justification: v4 repairs the garbled ablation-setup sentence in Section 5.6.2 and restores a clear reference to Section 5.2, providing a small readability improvement. The Appendix E.4 parameter revisions do not establish stronger empirical validity: all results remain unchanged, and the PDFs do not explain whether these are reporting corrections or reflect reruns.
